categories.main_business_segments: KTIS Corporation primarily operates in contact center services including KT Customer Center and Open Market contact centers, telephone directory assistance services (114 and priority number guidance), advertising services focused on priority number guidance, and distribution of KT's wired and wireless telecommunication products. The company also pursues new businesses such as digital commerce (wholesale distribution) and digital advertising (elevator TV advertising).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced contact center technologies including AI Contact Center (AICC) solutions integrating AI and human agents for efficient customer service. It operates proprietary systems for telephone directory assistance and digital signage platforms for elevator TV advertising. The business model relies on outsourcing, system integration, and solution development for contact centers, alongside digital content delivery technologies for advertising.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include KT (for KT Customer Center and 114 directory services), corporate clients across various sectors (public institutions, hospitals, finance, broadcasting, retail) for general contact center services, local small and medium-sized enterprises for advertising services, and end consumers and businesses for telecommunication product distribution. The digital commerce segment targets B2B and B2C customers, including hospitals for bed TV services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea, with headquarters in Seoul and multiple contact center locations nationwide. The company serves domestic markets exclusively, including nationwide coverage for KT-related services and regional advertising clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: KTIS operates mainly as a downstream service provider in the telecommunications value chain, focusing on customer contact centers, retail distribution of telecom products, and advertising services. It acts as an outsourcing partner and sales agent rather than a network infrastructure owner or manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding AI-driven contact center solutions (AICC), enhancing digital advertising platforms such as elevator TV, and growing digital commerce distribution channels. The company emphasizes innovation in customer service automation, multi-channel VOC management, and integration of CRM solutions. It also focuses on diversifying revenue streams through new business areas like financial product sales agency and comprehensive product distribution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service contracts for contact center operations (outsourcing and sales commissions), subscription and usage fees for telephone directory assistance and priority number advertising, sales margins from telecommunication product distribution, and advertising sales from digital media platforms. New business revenues come from digital commerce sales and digital advertising placements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KTIS holds a leading position in the Korean contact center outsourcing market with an estimated 5.5% market share. It competes with other large contact center operators and advertising media companies such as Focus Media and GS Netvision in the elevator TV advertising segment. The company differentiates itself through its partnership with KT, extensive operational experience, and integrated AI contact center solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, KTIS reported revenues of approximately 593 billion KRW, marking a 10.7% increase from the previous year, with operating profit of 20.5 billion KRW and net income of 13.9 billion KRW. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt ratio of 119% and equity ratio of 45.6%. Growth is driven by contact center and distribution businesses, alongside rapid expansion in digital advertising and commerce segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KTIS offers comprehensive, high-quality contact center services leveraging AI-enhanced solutions to improve productivity and customer satisfaction. Its exclusive operation of KT's customer centers and 114 directory services provides a stable revenue base with high entry barriers. The company’s digital advertising leverages unique elevator TV media with broad coverage and local advertising expertise, while its distribution business benefits from strong KT brand affiliation and multi-channel sales capabilities, enabling differentiated customer engagement and diversified revenue streams.
